method: Context-aware student ranker with action-only negative control
purpose: Train a student evaluator from full-teacher data, select one fixed candidate budget M on calibration calls, and screen that frozen M on held-out offline rankings.
claim_boundary: Stage A is offline ranking and readiness evidence only. It does not authorize chained student CEM, latency, native system timing, memory, or closed-loop claims.

scope.independence_unit: one independent Wall observation with one complete ten-round teacher CEM chain

fixed_settings.objective: Existing DINO-WM Wall planner objective; lower is better.
fixed_settings.tie_break: Stable ascending candidate-index tie-break after objective or score value.
fixed_settings.candidate_population_rule: The teacher objective and both student score arrays in each call describe the identical 300-candidate population.
fixed_settings.chain_rule: The full teacher alone updates chained CEM distributions; student scores are offline ranking observations and never update mu or sigma.
fixed_settings.checkpoint_and_preprocessing: The teacher, student, and action-only control use the same checkpoint-independent observation/action preprocessing contract for their respective recorded inputs.

teacher.name: full_teacher
teacher.definition: Existing full six-layer DINO-WM Wall predictor and unmodified planner objective.

student_context_aware.name: student_context_aware
student_context_aware.definition: Student score using observation/goal context and candidate action features, trained against full-teacher objective or ranking targets.

action_only_control.name: action_only_control
action_only_control.definition: Action-only negative-control score using candidate action features without observation/goal context.

training.teacher_data_record_unit: one train observation containing all ten chained CEM rounds
training.required_teacher_data: Each train observation has exactly ten rounds; each round records candidate_actions and exactly 300 finite J_full values plus the full-teacher CEM update states.

evaluation_records.record_unit: one observation containing all ten chained full-teacher rounds
evaluation_records.ranking_rule: The verifier stably ranks each 300-value array by (value, candidate index); no recorded top-M list is authoritative.

required_arrays.candidate_actions: A non-empty finite numeric array whose first dimension has length 300.
required_arrays.student_context_scores: Exactly 300 finite numeric values, lower is better.
required_arrays.student_action_only_scores: Exactly 300 finite numeric values, lower is better.

teacher_update.chain_continuity: For round r>0, input_mu and input_sigma equal the same observation's preceding output_mu and output_sigma.

selection_gate.call_definition: One observation-round pair; calibration has 4 observations x 10 rounds = 40 calls.
selection_gate.context_rule: Select the smallest M whose calibration context-aware recall has median exactly 1.0 and minimum at least 29/30.
selection_gate.action_only_rule: Report the same calibration metrics for action-only control; it is a negative control and is not a pass/fail gate.

heldout_gate.context_rule: At the one calibration-selected fixed M, heldout context-aware recall has median exactly 1.0 and minimum at least 29/30.
heldout_gate.action_only_rule: Report heldout action-only recall at the selected M; it does not determine the verdict.

result_decision.pass_verdict: PASS only when contract, split/schema/completeness, train-only provenance, calibration selection, and heldout context-aware gates all pass.
result_decision.pass_authorizes: A later separately frozen chained Stage B using the selected fixed M.

prohibited: Do not tune selected M using heldout records.
Do not train the student or action-only control on calibration or heldout observations.
Do not let student scores update CEM mu or sigma in Stage A.
Do not use hashes as a substitute for recorded values or comparisons.
Do not infer latency, native deployment, or closed-loop behavior from this offline screen.
